ai.synthesis: This face-scan wellness estimate shows multiple values outside the app's preset wellness thresholds across cardiovascular, autonomic, and experimental blood-related indicators, including Blood Pressure, Heart Rate, Wellness Score, High Blood Pressure Risk, PNS Zone (Recovery), and SNS Zone (Stress Response). Experimental estimates for Hemoglobin A1c, High Hemoglobin A1c Risk, and High Fasting Glucose Risk also exceed the app's preset thresholds, whereas Breathing Rate, Oxygen Saturation, Stress indices, and experimental estimates for Hemoglobin and High Total Cholesterol Risk remain within preset ranges. Because these values come from a consumer optical scan rather than validated clinical or laboratory instruments, they describe only how this single estimate compares to the app's built-in thresholds.

findings.label: Risks
findings.text: High Blood Pressure Risk is flagged High, exceeding the app's preset Low threshold, while High Hemoglobin A1c Risk and High Fasting Glucose Risk are experimental estimates flagged High that also exceed the app's preset Low threshold. High Total Cholesterol Risk and Low Hemoglobin Risk are experimental estimates within the app's preset Low threshold (with ASCVD Risk at 2% and Heart Age at 30 years).

findings.label: Basic Vital Signs
findings.text: Blood Pressure (154/94 mmHg) and Heart Rate (107 BPM) are flagged High because they exceed the app's preset wellness thresholds (< 129/90 mmHg and 60-100 BPM), and Wellness Score (5) falls outside the app's preset threshold (> 6). Breathing Rate (16 RPM) and Oxygen Saturation (99%) fall within the app's preset wellness ranges (with Wellness Level at 2 and PRQ at 6.5).

findings.label: Bloodless Blood Tests
findings.text: Hemoglobin A1c (6.89%) is an experimental estimate flagged High that exceeds the app's preset wellness threshold (< 5.7%), while Hemoglobin (14.4 g/dL) is an experimental estimate within the app's preset range. These experimental estimates are still under research and are not equivalent to laboratory blood tests.

findings.label: Stress
findings.text: Stress Level, Stress Index (120), and Normalized Stress Index (24%) all fall within the app's preset wellness thresholds.

findings.label: Advanced Heart Rate Variability
findings.text: PNS Zone (Recovery) is flagged Low, falling outside the app's preset wellness threshold, and SNS Zone (Stress Response) is flagged High, exceeding the app's preset wellness threshold. Additional recorded HRV metrics include PNS Index (-1.5), SNS Index (2.6), Mean RRI (559 ms), RMSSD (43 ms), SDNN (64 ms), SD1 (24 ms), SD2 (88 ms), and LF/HF Ratio (3.271).

next_steps: Schedule a visit with a licensed clinician to review the flagged Blood Pressure, Heart Rate, and experimental glucose/A1c estimates using validated clinical equipment and laboratory testing.
Check Blood Pressure and Heart Rate with a validated cuff or pulse oximeter while seated quietly at rest to see whether those values remain outside target ranges.
Repeat the face scan under standardized conditions—resting quietly for several minutes in even lighting without talking or moving—to compare consistency across readings.
Do not start, stop, or adjust any medications or treatment plans based on this app estimate alone.
ai.limitations: A single rPPG face-scan provides only a brief, non-clinical wellness snapshot that can be affected by lighting, motion, posture, or recent activity and cannot establish a medical status or substitute for laboratory blood work. This is a wellness estimate, not a diagnosis, and any flagged value should be confirmed with validated clinical equipment or a licensed clinician.
